title: The First Cry
author: Sarita Prusty
text:
From Egg to Foetus
Foetus to Baby
The Journey of Creating a Life
When begins

Days pass and month
And pass the sleepless nights
Somebody from Inside
Kicks for a hug tight

A mother`s eyes
Wait longingly
To have that divine Touch

Finally,
The Time comes
To see your own creation
The pain during labour
Forced to think more

In this battle of
Bringing your own
To the world
Suddenly comes
The First Cry
stanzas: The Journey of Creating a Life
